- [x] I agree to license this contribution under LICENSE.txt.
- [x] I ran scoped pre-commit hooks; Black, Black-Jupyter and SPDX passed.

## Affected area

CI or test infrastructure

## Summary

Print the selected native plan name when the shared SDPA harness records its routing. Previously only Python-engine routes printed an engine/knob identity, so a native MXFP8 backward failure could report its forward engine without identifying the backward plan that ran.

Read the selected unified plan index after build and use `get_plan_name_at_index`; preserve existing routing counters and the FROST `LAST_PLAN` / `LAST_ARMS` contract. Cover non-first plan selection and the existing Python-engine logging, plus a real built backend graph with FROST GEMM explicitly excluded.

## Related issues

Related to #2122. This supplies the missing backward-plan diagnostic for further reproduction. The intermittent SM100 NaN failure remains unverified on the available SM120 hardware.

## API and compatibility impact

Test logging only; no execution, numerical, tolerance or engine-admission changes.

## Testing

RTX 6000D (cc12.0), Python3.12.3, cuDNN9.27.0.42, Torch2.13.0+cu130, CuTeDSL4.8.0, source-bound frontend1.33.0:

- Before the change, the selected-native-plan regression failed for both index0 and index2; the Python-engine control passed.
- `python -m pytest sdpa/test_routing_diagnostics.py -m L0 -q`: 4 passed.
- Same command with `CUDNN_FRONTEND_ENABLE_FROST_ENGINES=1`: 4 passed.
- Scoped pre-commit hooks and `git diff --check`: passed.
- Independent review found no remaining issues after excluding FROST GEMM from the real native control.

files.patch:
@@ -16,7 +16,8 @@ def note_frost_routing(graph, label="graph"):
     this AFTER it: graph.selected_engine is the python engine that serves the
     graph, or None for the cuDNN backend. conftest.py prints the aggregate at
     the end of the run so the FROST-vs-native split stays visible while ops
-    transition to FROST.
+    transition to FROST. Also print the selected backend plan name so a failed
+    test identifies the native engine and knobs, not only the forward route.
     """
     import frost_routing
 
@@ -43,6 +44,10 @@ def note_frost_routing(graph, label="graph"):
             frost_routing.note(f"frost:{engine.name}:arms={arms}")
         frost_routing.LAST_ARMS = arms
     else:
+        index = getattr(graph, "_plan_index", None)
+        if index is not None:
+            name = graph.get_plan_name_at_index(index)
+            print(f"@@@@ {label} graph: native plan '{name}' serves this graph")
         frost_routing.note(f"native:{label}")
         frost_routing.LAST_PLAN = (None, None)
         frost_routing.LAST_ARMS = None

@@ -0,0 +1,69 @@
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+"""The SDPA harness reports the plan that actually served a native graph."""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+
+import frost_routing
+from sdpa.helpers import note_frost_routing
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.L0
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("selected", [0, 2])
+def test_native_routing_reports_selected_plan(selected, capsys, monkeypatch):
+    names = ["eng5_k24=2", "eng7_k24=1", "eng9_k24=3"]
+    graph = SimpleNamespace(selected_engine=None, _plan_index=selected, get_plan_name_at_index=names.__getitem__)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(frost_routing, "COUNTS", {})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(frost_routing, "LAST_PLAN", ("previous", {}))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(frost_routing, "LAST_ARMS", "previous")
+
+    note_frost_routing(graph, label="mxfp8-bwd")
+
+    assert f"mxfp8-bwd graph: native plan '{names[selected]}' serves this graph" in capsys.readouterr().out
+    assert frost_routing.COUNTS == {"native:mxfp8-bwd": 1}
+    assert frost_routing.LAST_PLAN == (None, None)
+    assert frost_routing.LAST_ARMS is None
+
+
+def test_python_routing_keeps_its_engine_and_knobs(capsys, monkeypatch):
+    engine = SimpleNamespace(name="sdpa_bwd_sm100_mxfp8")
+    graph = SimpleNamespace(selected_engine=engine, _selected_plan_config=SimpleNamespace(knobs={"tile_m": 128}))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(frost_routing, "COUNTS", {})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(frost_routing, "LAST_PLAN", (None, None))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(frost_routing, "LAST_ARMS", None)
+
+    note_frost_routing(graph, label="mxfp8-bwd")
+
+    output = capsys.readouterr().out
+    assert "python engine 'sdpa_bwd_sm100_mxfp8'" in output
+    assert "tile_m" in output
+    assert "native plan" not in output
+    assert frost_routing.COUNTS == {"frost:sdpa_bwd_sm100_mxfp8": 1}
+    assert frost_routing.LAST_PLAN == (engine.name, {"tile_m": 128})
+
+
+def test_native_routing_reports_a_real_built_graph(cudnn_handle, capsys):
+    import cudnn
+    from cudnn.engines.manifest import MANIFEST
+
+    graph = cudnn.pygraph(
+        handle=cudnn_handle,
+        io_data_type=cudnn.data_type.HALF,
+        intermediate_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT,
+        compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT,
+    )
+    a = graph.tensor(dim=[1, 16, 16], stride=[256, 16, 1])
+    b = graph.tensor(dim=[1, 16, 16], stride=[256, 16, 1])
+    graph.matmul(a, b).set_output(True).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.HALF)
+    graph.deselect_engines([name for family in MANIFEST if family.name == "frost_gemm" for name in family.slots])
+    graph.build([cudnn.heur_mode.A, cudnn.heur_mode.FALLBACK])
+    assert graph.selected_engine is None
+    selected_name = graph.get_plan_name_at_index(graph._plan_index)
+
+    note_frost_routing(graph, label="native-control")
+
+    assert f"native plan '{selected_name}' serves this graph" in capsys.readouterr().out
